definition: Apply domain knowledge to a concrete question.
Infer, calculate, prove, or solve a constrained problem.
Extract information from images, audio, video, or spatial observations.
Understand, translate, follow linguistic instructions, or communicate.
Acquire a new rule or transfer to a new task or environment.
Retain and retrieve information across context or time.
Choose and order actions under constraints.
Execute code, tools, interfaces, or physical actions.
Infer mental states or coordinate with other actors.
Produce a requested artifact or original content.
Recognize uncertainty, verify results, and recover from errors.
Resist harmful requests, bias, attacks, or disruptive conditions.
